keySentence: The garden brought them back to life.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Colin tried to stand up. Mary and Dickon helped him. He stood for the first time. The garden brought them back to life.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Colin came to the garden every day and grew a little stronger. One day he decided he would try to stand up on his own. Mary and Dickon held his arms as he pushed himself up. The garden brought them back to life with fresh air and love. Colin's legs shook but he stood there, smiling with tears of joy. The boy who thought he would die was learning to live again.
